definitions.explanation: The state of a country governing itself without control by another country. Political independence.
The state of being able to support oneself financially or emotionally without depending on others.

notes:
USAGE: {独立|どくりつ} has two main contexts:
1. Political independence of nations
2. Personal independence (financial, emotional, professional)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {独立|どくりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become independent)
- {独立|どくりつ}⟦{記念日|きねんび}→記念日：05585_kinenbi⟧ (Independence Day)
- {独立|どくりつ}⟦{国|こく}→国：noentry⟧ (independent nation)
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{独立|どくりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become financially independent)
- {独立|どくりつ}⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧ (starting one's own business)
- {独立|どくりつ}⟦{心|しん}→心：noentry⟧ (spirit of independence)

NUANCE: When someone says they {独立|どくりつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ from a company, it often means they started their own business in the same field.
